info.name: Employee Management API
info.description: Manual Postman collection for the implemented API, including private local employee-document uploads. Use development data only. Employee self-service and admin access-management requests require the matching account token. For directory, department writes, and admin operations, run npm run seed:dev-admin locally and paste its login access token into the adminAccessToken variable. Keep admin credentials out of this collection. The employeeId collection variable is automatically captured from Create employee or Get my profile; it is the employee profile ID, distinct from employeeUserId.

request.description: Requires the logged-in user access token.

exec: pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Session list is safe and structured', function () { pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); j.data.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s).to.include.all.keys('id','createdAt','expiresAt'); pm.expect(s).not.to.have.property('tokenHash'); }); });

request.description: Requires HR/admin access token. Automatically stores the account ID matching testEmail for the Create employee request.

exec: pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test('data is an array and contains no password fields', function () { pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); j.data.forEach(u => { pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); }); });

const match=j.data.find(u => u.email === pm.collectionVariables.get('testEmail')); pm.test('Registered test account is available to HR', function () { pm.expect(match, 'register the test account first and use an HR token').to.exist; }); if (match) pm.collectionVariables.set('employeeUserId', match.id);
